subject: Portal activation: MSA redline + vendor privacy/dataflow and PO field alignment
messages:
From: Alex Porter <aporter@medsupply.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement Ops <procure@medsupply.com>
Date: Sat, 1 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Portal onboarding: initial MSA redline and privacy/dataflow questions

Hi Michael / Jonas,

Thanks for the runbook — we're ready to start onboarding in Ariba but have a couple of legal / privacy questions before we flip the switch. Attached is our Ariba profile export for reference (medsupply_ariba_profile.xml).  Quick points from Procurement / Legal: 

- PO metadata: we need to confirm which fields Redwood will populate on invoices so our AP can auto-match (PO number, line-level SKU/quantity, tax id on header).
- Data residency & embeddings: our security team wants clarification on whether embeddings or logs are retained after inference and where that data sits (we're restricted to US-only storage for PII).
- Order form signatory: who will sign the Order Form for vendor activation — we have a preferred signer table and need the name/email to set on Ariba profile.

If helpful, we can do a 30-minute call this week to walk the field mappings and the redline items. Looping in Procurement Ops who manage our Ariba tenant.

Attachments: medsupply_ariba_profile.xml (xml)

Regards,
Alex Porter
Director, Strategic Sourcing
MedSupply Inc.
aporter@medsupply.com
+1 415-555-0192
From: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Porter <aporter@medsupply.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 2 Aug 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Portal onboarding: initial MSA redline and privacy/dataflow questions

Alex — thanks, and appreciate the Ariba export; that's helpful.  Quick answers and next steps from our side: 

- PO metadata: Redwood can populate header-level tax ID and remit address. For line-level SKU/quantity mapping we need Jonas to confirm field aliases in Ariba (we typically map to PO_LINE_NUMBER / PO_ITEM_ID). See attached: a draft PO field map we use with other Ariba customers.
- Embeddings & logs: Redwood's hosted inference by default keeps transient logs for 30 days and does not persist embeddings to long-term storage unless explicitly enabled. For regulated customers we offer a private deployment (VPC) or an opt-out retention policy. I'll include Marissa (contracts) for the DPA / data flow language.
- Order form signatory: Our standard signer on vendor activation is Finance Ops (Emily Ross). I can provide the exact email for your Ariba contact profile once legal confirms the Order Form version.

Action items I suggest:
1) Marissa to circulate our marked MSA (see msaredline_redline_080126.pdf) with specific edits to data processing and audit clauses.
2) Jonas to validate the attached PO field map against your medsupply_ariba_profile.xml and call out any mismatches.
3) Schedule a 30-min alignment call (Jonas, Alex, Michael, Marissa) — propose Tue/Wed next week.

I'll attach the Redwood redline and the PO map. If any of the above needs to be escalated to your legal, let us know.

--
Michael Grant
Director, Partnerships | Redwood Inference
michael_grant@redwood.ai
(650) 555-0124

Michael — thanks for the super quick reply. A few clarifications from Procurement: 

- PO mapping: we looked at your PO map and the Ariba export — main mismatch is SKU -> PO_LINE_PART_NUMBER vs PO_ITEM_ID. We can accept PO_ITEM_ID if Redwood can emit that field consistently.
- Data residency: MedSupply is US-only for any PII. We can accept transient 30-day logging, but embeddings must not be persisted outside our tenant. Would an opt-out/ephemeral mode be sufficient? Please have Marissa share the exact DPA clause language.
- Signatory: we'll provision Emily Ross (emily.ross@medsupply.com) on our Ariba side; please give us the signer email for Redwood.

Attaching: medsupply_ariba_profile.xml (from earlier) and our internal onboarding checklist (procurement_checklist.pdf).

We can do Wed 10:00 AM PT for the call. Let me know if that works.

Regards,
Alex

> Forwarded attachment: medsupply_ariba_profile.xml
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Porter <aporter@medsupply.com>, Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 5 Aug 2026 16:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Portal onboarding: initial MSA redline and privacy/dataflow questions

Alex — thanks for the replies and for proposing Wed at 10am PT; that works for our team.  A few notes from Contracts after reviewing the exchange and our counsel's redline: 

1) MSA redline highlights (attached msaredline_redline_080126.pdf):
   - Added a DPA appendix that clarifies "ephemeral inference" (no embeddings persisted) as an option for hosted customers.
   - Adjusted audit rights: we kept customer audit rights but limited frequency to once per 12 months for hosted plans (Private deployments retain full audit scope).
   - Updated liability cap language to align with Redwood standard (3x fees or $10M, whichever is lower).

2) Order form / PO requirements:
   - We will ensure Redwood emits PO_ITEM_ID (Jonas to implement mapping to PO_LINE_PART_NUMBER alias in Ariba) and header-level tax_id and remit address as discussed.
   - Please confirm whether MedSupply requires line-level tax or only header-level. If line-level is required we need to know the Tax Jurisdiction code used in your Ariba export.

3) Next steps & owners:
   - Jonas Weber (cc) to validate mapping and confirm the PO field list by EOD Mon.
   - Michael to provide Redwood Finance signer email for Ariba provisioning: finance_payments@redwood.ai (this is the address to provision).
   - Alex / MedSupply to confirm whether embeddings opt-out is acceptable in lieu of Private deployment. If MedSupply needs Private we can escalate.

Attachments: msaredline_redline_080126.pdf (redline), po_field_map_v2.xlsx (spreadsheet)

I will be on the Wed call; agenda will be: 1) review PO mapping mismatches, 2) confirm DPA language options (ephemeral vs private), 3) timeline for activation and signer provisioning.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Sr. Contracts Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai
(650) 555-0188
